recipes.title: Weeknight Lentil Soup
recipes.intro: A sample recipe with a single ingredient list.
steps: Warm the oil in a large pot and cook the onion and carrots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and cumin and stir for a minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils fall apart.
Stir in the lemon juice and season to taste.
